summary: Gix Internet Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 30, 2026, announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary deliverz.ai was granted a South Korean patent (Application No. 10-2022-7013675) titled 'Navigation Indication of a Vehicle,' following an August 2026 allowance. The patent covers vision-based vehicle navigation methods supporting autonomous vehicle and robot routing, extending protection alongside existing European and Israeli grants. CEO Amir Nardimon framed it as strengthening the Physical AI platform for hospital logistics. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation or advisor is involved; this is a routine intellectual-property update with no special-situation or deal-risk angle.
